info.title: Ear infections and your hearing
info.subtitle: How they dull sound, and when muffled hearing needs a look

rows.title: Fluid muffles sound
rows.desc: Fluid behind the eardrum blocks vibrations from passing.

rows.title: Usually temporary
rows.desc: Hearing typically returns as the infection clears.

rows.title: Watch repeat infections
rows.desc: Frequent or lingering cases can affect hearing over time.

rows.title: Rule out earwax
rows.desc: A wax plug can cause the same muffled, plugged feeling.

rows.title: Get checked if it lingers
rows.desc: Muffled hearing that stays deserves a professional look.
